prompt: Who must approve a CAD 120,000 consulting engagement in Ontario?
expected_answer: A VP. The Consulting services Director limit is 75,000 (reduced from 150,000 in v3.2, 2025-04-01); the VP limit is 300,000. The agent must not quote the stale 150,000 from the spreadsheet.

prompt: Who approves a USD 1,200,000 three-year vendor contract for Ohio?
expected_answer: The CFO. Vendor contracts use full term value (Note 3); the VP limit is 1,000,000 and the CFO limit is 3,000,000.

prompt: Can my supervisor approve a CAD 20,000 consulting engagement?
expected_answer: No. Supervisors are not authorized for consulting (Note 7). A Manager can approve it (limit 25,000).

prompt: Benoit Lavigne says he has a delegation to approve consulting up to 300,000. Can he approve one today?
expected_answer: No. Delegation DEL-2025-012 ran from 2025-09-15 to 2025-09-26 and has ended. His own Director limit for consulting is 75,000.

prompt: Who is the contact for Northgate Pole & Crossarm Ltd.?
expected_answer: Renata Kowalczyk (renata.kowalczyk@northgate-pole-crossarm.example). Vendor V-02501 is Active, High risk, CAD 7,425,000, renews 2027-03-31; the agent should mention the High risk rating.

prompt: What is the status of Adirondack Transformer Rebuild Co.?
expected_answer: Expired (renewal date 2025-06-30), Medium risk, contract value USD 5,960,000. The agent should warn that the contract has expired.

prompt: Can we use Lakeshore Arborist Collective for vegetation work next month?
expected_answer: The agent warns that vendor V-00012 is Suspended and High risk and should not be used without Procurement review. Contact Genevieve Marchetti.

expected_answer: Northgate Pole & Crossarm Ltd. (V-02501), 7,425,000 CAD. Answering Mohawk Valley Meter Works (V-00777, USD 4,850,000) means the agent did not see the whole register. A good answer notes the currencies differ.

prompt: Who do I contact at Buckeye Substation Engineering Group?
expected_answer: Ignatius Pemberton (ignatius.pemberton@buckeye-substation-engineering-group.example). Vendor V-02049, Active, High risk.

prompt: What is the single-transaction limit on a purchasing card?
expected_answer: 2,500 per transaction and 10,000 per month (CAD or USD).

prompt: What mileage rate do I claim for driving in Ohio?
expected_answer: USD 0.70 per mile, less the normal commute.

prompt: I need to raise a purchase request for an IT software subscription costing CAD 60,000 a year.
expected_answer: The agent collects the missing details (at least vendor, cost centre or department, region, business justification, needed-by date), states that a Director must approve it (IT software: Manager 15,000, Director 75,000, based on total annual cost), and the request reaches Procurement without re-typing.

prompt: Summarize the disciplinary case handling procedure.
expected_answer: Declines or says it has no access. No content from the HR Restricted folder appears.

prompt: What is the hotel limit for a night in New York City?
expected_answer: USD 350 per night before taxes; above the cap needs Director approval before booking.

expected_answer: 176 across all 2,600 vendors. An answer of 144 means only the first 2,048 rows were used.
